paraphrase: Eight pentads and one group of three are to be known; the one who knows these nine groups and consecrates [the disciple] is called the teacher.

original.text: pañcakās tv aṣṭa vijñeyā gaṇaś caikas trikātmakaḥ | vettā navagaṇasyāsya saṃskartā gurur ucyate

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw.

paraphrase: The eight pentads are gains, impurities, means, places, stages, purifications, factors of initiation and strengths; the three are the livelihoods.

original.text: lābhā malā upāyāś ca deśāvasthāviśuddhayaḥ | dīkṣākāribalāny aṣṭa pañcakās trīṇi vṛttayaḥ

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw.

paraphrase: Strength is fivefold: devotion to the teacher, clarity of mind, conquest of the pairs of opposites, merit, and vigilance.

original.text: gurubhaktiḥ prasādaś ca mater dvandvajayas tathā | dharmaś caivāpramādaś ca balaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtam

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw.

paraphrase: Purification is fivefold: loss of ignorance, of demerit, of what causes attachment, of falling away, and of the paśu-state.

original.text: ajñānahāny adharmasya hāniḥ saṅgakarasya ca | cyutihāniḥ paśutvasya śuddhiḥ pañcavidhā smṛtā

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw.

paraphrase: The stages are the manifest, the unmanifest, conquest, cutting and completion as the fifth; the factors of initiation are material, time, rite, image and teacher as the fifth.

original.text: vyaktāvyaktaṃ jayacchedo niṣṭhā caiveha pañcamī | dravyaṃ kālaḥ kriyā mūrtiḥ guruś caiveha pañcamaḥ

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw.

paraphrase: The places are the teacher, people, the cave, the cremation ground and Rudra; the gains are knowledge, austerity, permanence, steadiness and perfection as the fifth.

original.text: gurur janaguhādeśaḥ śmaśānaṃ rudra eva ca | jñānaṃ tapo 'tha nityatvaṃ sthitiḥ siddhiś ca pañcamī

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw. The Sarvadarśanasaṃgraha, quoting this as Haradatta's, reads 'śuddhi' for 'siddhi'.

paraphrase: Residence, observance, muttering-and-meditation, constant remembrance of Rudra, and grace are the five sure means to the gains.

original.text: vāsaś caryā japadhyānaṃ sadārudrasmṛtis tathā | prasādaś caiva lābhānām upāyāḥ pañca niścitāḥ

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw. The Ratnaṭīkā glosses japa and dhyāna separately; the Sarvadarśanasaṃgraha reads 'pratipatti' for 'prasāda'.

paraphrase: False knowledge, demerit, the cause of attachment, falling away and the root of the paśu-state - these five are the impurities to be abandoned in this system.

original.text: mithyājñānam adharmaś ca saktihetuś cyutis tathā | paśutvamūlaṃ pañcaite tantre heyādhikārikāḥ

notes: Checked against the Muktabodha e-text M00508 of the Ganakarika with Ratnatika (C. D. Dalal ed., GOS 15, Baroda 1920) in sources_raw.
